assertion_audit.test_a_commitless_promotion_finishes_bes: Restoring preparation-slot retention prevents the second executor event before the independently controlled release; base-control-final.log reproduces this failure.
assertion_audit.test_a_detached_checkout_keeps_its_lease: Keying detached leases by commit contents changes the separately captured key after HEAD changes.
assertion_audit.test_a_refusal_releases_the_branch_and_r: Leaking the first writer lease prevents the promoted phase; including refusals in success counts changes expected one/one counters and hourly rate; omitting stage attribution fails membership. Wait-for-in-flight assertions reject unfinished threads but alone do not prove successful execution.
assertion_audit.test_archived_run_records_and_historical: Dropping historical pointer/archive fallback changes literal repo or manifest content; any write changes the separately captured inventory.
assertion_audit.test_changed_copied_set_is_refused: Removing digest validation accepts the explicitly modified dataset instead of raising.
assertion_audit.test_distinct_attempts_of_one_run_remain: Deduplicating by run_id alone changes the independently expected count from two to one.
assertion_audit.test_empty_real_replay_reports_no_rate: Accepting empty replay rather than raising loses the required exception.
assertion_audit.test_empty_request_directory_reports_no_: Fabricating a row changes zero count; accepting an empty set loses the expected ValueError.
assertion_audit.test_landings_for_different_repositories: Retaining preparation slots through writes or sharing all repositories under one lease prevents the second event before release; base control fails.
assertion_audit.test_linked_checkouts_of_one_branch_shar: Keying named branches by private gitdir changes the equal-key assertion; ignoring the branch name fails the unequal-key assertion after the fixture changes HEAD.
assertion_audit.test_locked_promotion_reads_its_target_i: Removing the execution-time operational_read decorator makes pointers omit the supplied target and fails its equality assertion; bypassing the checked body fails the expected RuntimeError.
assertion_audit.test_private_repository_copies_packs_wit: Wrong checkout changes known content or HEAD; failing to copy loose objects fails show after removing alternates; changing source or copied packs changes independently read bytes. The HEAD assertion compares against a revision independently read from the source repository, not a constant returned by the callee.
assertion_audit.test_real_replay_exercises_guards_and_a_: Removing acquire before ledger.append_run fails the observer; bypassing the writer fails appended; disabling promotion guards changes the expected refused verdict; any source write changes inventory. This does not observe release updates.
assertion_audit.test_relocation_uses_the_longest_path_an: Removing relocation or pid clearing changes literal output; longest-path precedence itself is NOT distinguished because the parent and child substitutions yield the same string, so no durability credit is assigned for that claimed precedence.
assertion_audit.test_replay_refuses_a_write_to_its_origi: Removing the audit-hook write refusal loses PermissionError, changes source content or leaves refusal count zero.
assertion_audit.test_replay_store_is_seeded_before_it_be: Omitting seed leaves no known row; losing relocation leaves the old path; leaking synchronous=OFF beyond the disposable connection changes the independent new-connection PRAGMA reading.
assertion_audit.test_retained_request_supersedes_the_sam: Prioritizing the historical record loses the promoted phase; keeping both changes count.
assertion_audit.test_selection_uses_request_time_and_kee: Including either excluded endpoint or dropping a retained lower/middle request changes the independently enumerated count or names.
assertion_audit.test_two_landings_on_one_branch_never_ov: Removing branch exclusion allows the second executor event while release is unset; base-control-final.log reproduces this failure. It does not prove the second executor eventually succeeds rather than refusing.

assertion_independence: No assertion is counted as a throughput or verdict-parity guard merely because it echoes a configured input; source revision, bytes, inventories and controlled event state are independent observations. Two limits are explicitly recorded in assertion_audit.

failure_delta_evidence.note: The required armed pair adds zero failures; the broader importer run separately reports one added ID, and is not substituted for this pair.

findings.text: blocking: the delivered real head replay fails after 1800 seconds with 46 active requests, while the base completed at 84.8639 successful promotions/hour; neither the required threefold gain nor all-request verdict equivalence is demonstrated, and the live-home listing equality check is false in both arm logs, so complete quantitative evidence is required before landing.

blocking: acquiring the branch lease only at the commit wrapper is too late for its release-record caller, which updates the shared ledger in promotion_release.py:803 before calling this wrapper at :845; after the first landing releases its lease another promotion can write concurrently with that release update, contradicting same-branch write serialization and confirmed by release-lease-probe.log's AssertionError: release record writes before acquiring the branch lease.

item_verdicts.diff: read the fifteen commits from 606afde873e4bd9e8425c33892fd944b6c33a9c3 through 8ed595380ba2351031e4a0ffc43e2f88e664db03; the five-file diff extends the existing drain and lease owner and adds an isolated real replay with nineteen tests, but the release writer is outside the lazy lease boundary.
item_verdicts.done_when: prompt.txt:260 and live plan section 4 require the concurrency cases, a paired real replay and no added importer failures; delivery-integrated-gate.log records 77 passes, but the real replay comparison is incomplete and the manifest reports one added importer failure.
item_verdicts.goal: prompt.txt:38 requires at least 30 successful promotions/hour without wasting blocked slots; promotion_scope.py adds lazy branch admission, but real-head-native.log ends with a timeout and does not establish the throughput goal.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md records the fifteen commits, green assigned arms, three failing base concurrency controls, a completed base replay and a timed-out head replay, while its complete status expressly leaves the quantitative measure unmet.
item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt:95 and resume-2-advice.txt grant the original seven paths plus promotion.py and promotion_scope.py; all five changed paths are within that expanded scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_drain_keeps_up_with_a_burst.py:290 and :320 fail when preparation handoff or branch exclusion is reverted, as base-control-final.log demonstrates, but the real append observer at :187 covers no release update and the longest-path fixture at :131 gives both mappings the same result.
justifications.evidence: delivery-integrated-gate.log records 77 passed against baseline-assigned.log's 58 passed, but real-head-native.log:22 records EXIT=1 and both native replay logs report original_listing_unchanged: False, leaving the main quantitative and isolation measures unproven.
justifications.fit: promotion_scope.py:68 follows the existing context-manager ownership pattern and promotion_requests.py:81 extracts its existing HostLease claim rather than replacing it, with capability-based source names and bounded waits.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/replay_promotion_drain.py:426 times out on the real changed cohort with 46 requests active, so the new branch scheduling in promotion_scope.py:97 has not delivered the required rate or per-request verdict parity.
justifications.reuse: promotion_requests.py:81 extends its existing claim owner, promotion_scope.py:97 uses host_lease.py:76 and the existing renewer, and searches of the crew modules and scripts found only pace_replay.py:98's allowance replay and reproduce_landing_reversion.py's rollback reproduction, neither owning real request-cohort draining.
justifications.scope_discipline: the five paths in the base-to-head diff are covered by prompt.txt:95 and the explicit two-file extension in resume-2-advice.txt, and all changes serve promotion scheduling or its measurement.

notes: Review only: no production edits, no suite rerun, no change to shared plan state. False live inventory comparison is a failed measure, not proof the replay caused external concurrent changes.
